title: A star-shaped match
caption: Each phone sends its input and receives delta snapshots against the last confirmed tick; networked play needs HTTPS for WebRTC.

host.label: Projector
host.note: It simulates the match and shows the QR. It accepts only the host's state: game consistency, apart from security.

p1.label: Phone 1
p1.note: Joins through the QR, sends its input to the projector and receives the match state.

p2.label: Phone 2
p2.note: Another controller, on its own direct channel to the projector: each phone talks only to the host.

p3.label: Phone 3
p3.note: Depending on the game, the phone is a controller or runs the whole match on the device.

broker.label: Signalling
broker.note: A public broker, only to connect: after that each phone talks directly to the projector over a DataChannel.

bc.label: Local mode
bc.note: During development, two tabs act as projector and phone over BroadcastChannel, with simulated latency and loss; every game runs the same.
